swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW). Soldering AP63205WU-7 onto a AP62300WU-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL FEEDBACK LAYOUT DIFFERENCE: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; adding or removing the external R1/R2 feedback divider and feedforward capacitor requires a PCB layout change.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 32% (AP62300WU-7: 750 kHz p.5 vs AP63205WU-7: 1100 kHz p.5); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP62300WU-7: 3.3 µH p.17 vs AP63205WU-7: 4.7 µH p.13); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (AP62300WU-7: 18 V p.4 vs AP63205WU-7: 32 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP62300WU-7 specifies 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs AP63205WU-7 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP62300WU-7 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (20 V, p.4) than AP63205WU-7 (35 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 20 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 27% higher on AP63205WU-7 (AP62300WU-7: 70 °C/W p.4 vs AP63205WU-7: 89 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
CAUTION EN ABS MAX: EN pin absolute maximum differs (AP62300WU-7: 8 V vs AP63205WU-7: 35 V); tying EN directly to VIN may exceed the lower rating.
engineering_verdict: AP62300WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and AP63205WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW); fixed vs adjustable output feedback footprint mismatch (R1/R2 divider). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs FB), Pin 2 (SW vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs GND), Pin 5 (EN vs SW). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 750 kHz (p.5) vs 1100 kHz (p.5) (1.5x ratio), typical inductor 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 4.7 µH (p.13), output mode adjustable vs fixed, and package θJA 70 vs 89 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP62300WU-7 "CRITICAL: Pin 5 (EN) Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — Direct 12 V VIN Tie Destroys AP62300WU-7" (p.4) and AP63205WU-7 "Pin-Identical Fixed 5.0 V vs 3.3 V Overvoltage Hazard — AP63205WU-7 ('T5') vs AP63203WU-7 ('T4')" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose AP62300WU-7 when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required; choose AP63205WU-7 when bus voltage exceeds 18 V (rated to 32 V) or light-load battery standby needs 22 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
